note: No-frills wooded campground half a block off US-13 at the Delaware line in Delmar, on Maryland's lower Eastern Shore. Dump-station use is $20. Third-party listings count 32 sites with 14 pull-throughs and put the season at April-October; the operator states neither, nor a maximum RV length. The campground is heavily wooded with pruned trees, which is why the pads do not read on satellite. Note the town straddles the state line - the campground is on the Maryland side though some directories file it under Delmar, DE. --Claude
